QuestInfo.0: Just the #t4037400# won't be enough. Go get better medicine.
QuestInfo.1: Just the #t4037400# won't be enough. Go get better medicine.
QuestInfo.2: Troubled that you didn't have more energy to give to Saya, you hear of a #t4037403# and head to the Traveler's Guild to purchase it. However, it had already sold to a trader. You took commissions from the guild to buy the elixir from the trader.
